svg.title: Delegating lease authority was not the same as awarding a lease
svg.desc: Evidence-based comparison of Louisiana Lakefront Management Authority actions on July 25, 2024: a committee recommended a 107-acre Bohemia application, the full board adopted a distinct delegation of leasing authority with nine yes votes, and the published full-board minutes listed the application without recording its disposition. No signed lease or production is established by these minutes.
svg.metadata: Creator: Final Vestige Studios. Date: 2026-11-17. Copyright: © 2026 Final Vestige Studios, original self-contained SVG diagram. Sources: https://nolalakefront.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/25-JULY-2024-Commercial-Real-estate-Committee-Minutes_Approved-9.19.2024.pdf ; https://wwwcfprd.doa.louisiana.gov/BoardsAndCommissions/MeetingMinutes/547_JULY%2025%202024%20Board%20Minutes_approved.pdf . No third-party imagery, clip art, photo or AI-generated historical reconstruction. Suggested caption: The same meeting date produced a confirmed mineral-leasing delegation but no recorded disposition of a separately listed 107-acre application in the available full-board minutes. Alt text: July 2024 LMA committee recommendation, adopted delegation, and application with no recorded board result are distinguished; no executed lease is shown.
